meta.title: Remote control
meta.description: A right-sidebar console for Android phones and TVs: auto-discovery over wireless ADB (no manual IP), live screen view, tappable system keys, text input, AI control that lets a multimodal model look at the screen and act on its own, computer-to-device casting, device-to-device relaying, file transfer and APK install; plus phone_* tools for the Agent.
